{
  "name": "spotify-claude-code-mod",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "description": "Claude Code mod for Spotify: control the Spotify desktop app from Claude Code on macOS: now playing with progress, play/pause/next/previous, volume, shuffle, repeat, play a Spotify link or search for a track. Other plugins can use it through `$.spotify`. Fixed osascript scripts only, no daemon, no state file.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/gfb-47/spotify-claude-code-mod",
  "repository": "https://github.com/gfb-47/spotify-claude-code-mod",
  "keywords": [
    "spotify",
    "music",
    "macos",
    "applescript",
    "now-playing",
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "mod",
    "plugin"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "spotify_client_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Spotify client ID",
      "description": "From an app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard; only needed for search",
      "required": false
    },
    "spotify_client_secret": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Spotify client secret",
      "description": "The secret of the same Spotify app; kept in secure storage and only ever sent to Spotify",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    }
  }
}
